description: This file defines the ApiService interface for network communication, along with data classes representing API responses related to workouts, categories, and home screen content.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for fetching home content, workouts, and recommendations.

classes.name: HomeResponse
classes.description: Represents the data structure for the home screen content including favorites, recent workouts, ongoing, and categories.

classes.name: WorkoutsResponse
classes.description: Container for a list of workout items.

classes.name: WorkoutDetailResponse
classes.description: Contains detailed information for a specific workout.

classes.name: WorkoutItem
classes.description: Represents a summary of a workout with id, title, thumbnail, duration, level, and category.

classes.name: WorkoutDetail
classes.description: Provides detailed workout information, including description, video, and equipment.

classes.name: CategoryItem
classes.description: Represents a workout category with id, name, and hero image.

methods.name: getHome
methods.description: Fetches home screen sections such as categories, favorites, recent, and continue watching.

methods.name: getWorkouts
methods.description: Fetches a list of workouts, optionally filtered by category, level, and duration.

methods.name: getWorkout
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a workout by its ID.

methods.name: getRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches personalized workout recommendations for the current user.
